items.title: Ardonagh expands Orvia brand globally in US$3bn MGA platform overhaul
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, the Ardonagh Group is extending its Orvia brand worldwide, bringing over US$3 billion in gross written premium under a unified MGA platform identity across multiple regions.

items.title: Swiss Re highlights client proximity and secondary peril challenges for EMEA reinsurance
items.summary: According to Reinsurance News, swiss Re expects varied pricing across EMEA at the upcoming January 2027 renewals, stressing a deal-by-deal approach to manage diverse markets and secondary natural catastrophe risks.

items.title: Marsh advises European businesses against affirmative AI cyber cover
items.summary: According to Commercial Risk, marsh is cautioning European companies not to actively seek affirmative artificial intelligence coverage in cyber policies to prevent potential restrictions in protection.

items.title: Financial Conduct Authority Issues Warning Over Bondsterling Savings Ltd Clone
items.summary: According to Financial Conduct Authority, the UK financial regulator has warned consumers about an unauthorised entity masquerading as a legitimate authorised firm.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway Specialty Insurance Promotes Virginie Pelletier in France
items.summary: According to Commercial Risk, virginie Pelletier steps up to lead executive and professional liability operations for BHSI in France.

items.title: M&G launches CDI+ run-on solution backed by £400m deal
items.summary: According to Professional Pensions, new offering combines asset management and insurance capabilities to give defined benefit pension schemes more flexibility.
